description: This file defines a Java interface 'ConnectionLimitManager' which enforces upper limits on concurrent connections. It declares a method 'isLimitExceeded' to check if the connection limit has been exceeded.

classes.name: ConnectionLimitManager
classes.description: An interface that enforces an upper limit on concurrent connections and provides a method to check if the limit has been exceeded.

methods.name: isLimitExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the number of current connections has reached or exceeded the pre-defined limit; returns true if so.
